DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, west Triangle, Quezon City http://wmov.dilq.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 88 s. 2021 July 22, 2021 HON. GAYLORD B. GUMPAL Municipal Vice Mayor Municipality of Jones, Province of Isabela Dear Vice Mayor Gumpal: This in reference to your letter dated 17 February 2021 seeking this Department's legal opinion on the issue of 'Whether or Not the unexpended honoraria of Sangguniang Kabataan Chairperson can be utilized as payment for the Productivity Enhancement Incentive (PEI) of Barangay Officials. " The concern arose because of the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Chairperson Magie L. Pasion's unauthorized leave of absences from 01 March 2020 to 01 August 2020 and her subsequent resignation. As a result, the unutilized honorarium amounting to PhP 27,800.00 was declared as savings. By reason thereof, the Sangguniang Bayan of Daligan, Jones, Isabela, passed a Supplemental Budget authorizing the grant of PEI to barangay officials soured from the previously declared savings by virtue of Appropriation Ordinance No. 002, entitled "An Ordinance Authorizing Supplemental Budget No. 002, Series of 2020 Involving an Amount of Twenty-Seven Thousand Eight Hundred Pesos (PhP 27,800.00) and Appropriating the Necessary Funds for the Purpose. " Hence, herein query. Foremost, please be informed that the Department is an agency under the executive branch of the govemment and as such, it has no authority to declare invalid any ordinance or resolution of the local sanggunians, or any act committed by the members thereof which is alleged to be in violation of the LGC or other applicable laws. Only the courts have the authority to do so upon initiation of the appropriate action. Nevertheless, for purposes of academic discussion and to properly guide you on the matter, we shall discuss the provisions of law which per

our view are applicable in the case at hand. In this regard, attention is invited to Section 322 of the Local Government Code of 1991, regarding unexpended balances of appropriation, to wit: "SECTION 322. Reversion of Unexpended Balances of Appropriations, Continuing Appropriations. Unexpended balances of appropriations authorized in the annual appropriations ordinance shall revert to the unappropriated surplus of the general fund at the end of the fiscal year and shall not thereafter be available for the expendituæ except by subsequent enactment. However, appropriations for capital outlays shall continue and remain valid until fully spent, reverted or the project is completed. Reversions of continuing appropriations shall not be allowed unless obligations therefor have been fully paid or otherwise settled. The balances of continuing appropriations shall be reviewed as part of the annual budget preparation and the sanggunian concemed may approve, upon recommendation of the local chief executive, the reversion of funds no longer needed in connection with the activities funded by said continuing appropriations subject to the provisions of this section. " In relation thereto, it is worthy to note that pursuant to Section 3361 of the same Code, transfer of appropriations from one item to another is proscribed; funds shall be used exclusively for the specific purpose for which they have been appropriated. However, augmentation of any item in the approved annual budget from savings in other items within the same expense class (in the respective appropriations for the offices of the local chief executive or presiding officer of the sanggunian) may be authorized through an ordinance2. Accordingly, it is our view that as long as the funds for which the honorarium of former SK Chairperson is sourced from is within the same class of the approved annual budget, and the same observes the general limitation provided in Section 325 and 331 of the LGC, the same may be allowed to be used as source of PEI for barangay officials. 1 SECTION 336. Use of Appropriated Funds and Savings. — Funds shall be available exclusively for the specific purpose for Miich they have been appropriated. No ordinance shall be passed authorizing any transfer of appropriations from one item to another. However, the local chief executive or the presiding officer of the sanggunian concerned may, by ordinance, be authorized to augment any item in the approved annual budget for their respective offices from savings in other items within the same expense class of their respective appropriations. 2 DILG Legal Opinion No. 06, Series of 2015

This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you.
